terms.definition: A chart showing data as bars whose heights equal their values.
terms.whereItIs: The chart plate with its bars.
terms.whyItMatters: The most common chart for comparing groups.

terms.definition: The bottom axis naming the groups compared.
terms.function: Places one bar under each category.
terms.whereItIs: Red, Blue, Green along the bottom.
terms.whyItMatters: Tells you what each bar stands for.

terms.definition: The side axis measuring the counts.
terms.function: Provides the scale for reading bar heights.
terms.whyItMatters: The value axis turns heights into numbers.

terms.definition: Judge which category is larger by comparing heights.
terms.whereItIs: Visible by scanning the bar tops.
